summary_out.changed: Layered a second OPEN-gate on top of the position-tier-gate base: skip new entries when the latest top-of-book spread exceeds the p75 of a 60s rolling spread distribution (min 50 samples).
summary_out.outcome: pnl +26.55% vs position-tier-gate (5394.25 vs 4262.50), sharpe 23.17 vs 17.62, trade_count -3.4% (87319 vs 90433), is_weighted_bps -26.8% (0.0285 vs 0.0389), max_drawdown_pct tightened to -0.0061 vs -0.0173; mean_slippage 0.0 on both sides (sim fills at top-of-book — slippage delta undefined, reported as 0.0).
summary_out.hypothesis: Wide-spread moments coincide with brief liquidity vacuums where the oracle's 30s forward signal is more likely to reverse before the CLOSE leg fires; filtering the upper quartile of recent spreads should remove the highest-adverse-selection slice while preserving most entries.
summary_out.next: Try a multiplicative-quantile combo (e.g. p60 + an absolute floor in ticks) to remove the warm-up dependency on a min_samples threshold; also test whether the gate transfers when applied to other islands' bases — it should generalize to any algo that does not already condition on spread.
